blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Distinguishing GPT-assisted from independently authored student writing has become a critical challenge in academia. This paper evaluates the discriminative capability of interpretable stylometric features extracted solely from submitted text. Using data from 90 90 participants who wrote both independently and with ChatGPT assistance, we evaluate eight machine learning classifiers while keeping data from the same participant together during validation. On the held-out test set, Random Forest achieved an ROC-AUC of 0.870 0.870 and an F1-score of 0.842 0.842 , with False Positive and False Negative rates of 22.2 % 22.2\% and 11.1 % 11.1\% , respectively. SHAP analysis shows that lexical and grammatical characteristics drive the resulting predictions. The findings suggest that transparent, text-intrinsic features provide measurable signal for detecting GPT-assisted writing.
blocks.zh: 区分GPT协助与独立作者的学生写作,已成为学术界的关键性挑战. 本文件评价了仅从提交的案文中提取的可解释性定型特征的歧视性能力。 我们利用90名参与者提供的数据,他们既独立写作,又在ChatGPT的协助下写作,评估了8个机器学习分类器,同时在验证过程中将同一参与者的数据放在一起. 在被搁置的测试中,Random Forest取得了0.870 0.870的ROC-AUC和0.842 0.842的F1-分数,假正负率和假负率分别为22.2% 22.2% 和 11.1% 11.1% 11.1% 。 SHAP分析显示,词汇学和语法特征驱动了由此产生的预测. 研究结果表明,透明、文字内涵的特征为检测GPT辅助写作提供了可衡量的信号。

blocks.en: Keywords: AI text detection, stylometry, interpretable machine learning
blocks.zh: 关键词:AI文本检测,造型,可解释的机器学习

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have changed how students produce written assignments. While they can provide personalized tutoring, on-demand explanations, brainstorming assistance, and writing support, they also raise concerns regarding authorship and academic integrity ( unesco2023chatgpt ; Kundu et al., 2024 ; Roh et al., 2025 ; Mehta et al., 2026 ) . Recent evidence indicates that student AI use in education has become routine rather than exceptional. In the Lumina Foundation–Gallup 2026 State of Higher Education Study, 57 % 57\% of currently enrolled U.S. college students reported using AI in their coursework at least weekly, including about one in five who reported using it daily. More than half reported using AI daily or weekly to edit or improve their writing, and 36 % 36\% reported using it daily or weekly to write papers ( Gallup, 2026 ) . As GPT-assisted writing becomes increasingly integrated into educational workflows, institutions require reliable methods for distinguishing independently authored and GPT-assisted student work.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)改变了学生如何产生书面任务. 虽然他们可以提供个性化辅导、按需解释、集思广益和写作支持,但也引起对作者身份和学术诚信(unesco2023chatgpt)的关切; Kundu等人,2024年;Roh等人,2025年;Mehta等人,2026年). 最近有证据表明,学生在教育中使用AI已成为例行而非例外。 在Lumina Foundation – Gallup 2026州高等教育研究中,57%的美国大学生报告至少每周一次在课程工作中使用AI,其中大约五分之一的学生报告每天使用AI。 超过半数报道使用AI每日或每周编辑或改进他们的写作,36%的36 %报道使用AI每日或每周撰写论文(Gallup,2026年). 随着GPT辅助写作日益融入教育工作流程,各机构需要可靠的方法来区分独立作者和GPT辅助学生的工作.

blocks.en: This need has led to rapid growth in AI text detection research. Existing approaches include statistical detection and visualization tools such as GLTR ( Gehrmann et al., 2019 ) , zero-shot detection methods such as DetectGPT ( Mitchell et al., 2023 ) , watermarking approaches that embed detectable signals during text generation ( Kirchenbauer et al., 2023 ) , adversarially trained detectors such as RADAR ( Hu et al., 2023 ) , and fine-grained detection systems including LLM-DetectAIve ( Abassy et al., 2024 ) . Recent studies have also explored behavioral approaches based on keystroke dynamics ( Kundu et al., 2024 ; Roh et al., 2025 ; Mehta et al., 2026 ) . Although these techniques have reported reasonable performance, recent studies have questioned detector robustness under recursive paraphrasing ( Sadasivan et al., 2023 ) and stylistic or text-complexity variation ( Doughman et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 这种需要导致了AI文本检测研究的快速增长. 现有方法包括统计检测和可视化工具,如GLTR(Gehrmann等人,2019年),探测GPT(Mitchell等人,2023年)等零镜头检测方法,在文本生成过程中嵌入可探测信号的水印方法(Kirchenbauer等人,2023年),对抗性训练的RADAR(Hu等人,2023年)等探测器,以及包括LLM-DetectAIve(Abassy等人,2024年)在内的细纹检测系统. 最近的研究还探讨了基于按键动态的行为方法(Kundu等人,2024年;Roh等人,2025年;Mehta等人,2026年)。 虽然这些技术报告了合理的性能,但最近的研究质疑在递归性抛射(Sadasivan等人,2023年)和结构或文本复杂性变异(Doughman等人,2024年)下探测器的强度。

blocks.en: A key challenge is detecting GPT-assisted writing while also providing an additional layer of evidence that instructors can examine during academic integrity investigations. Misconduct decisions may affect grades and disciplinary actions. Such decisions require explanations that instructors and review committees can examine, not opaque prediction scores from proprietary models whose internal evidence cannot be inspected. The explainable artificial intelligence literature frames explanations as a way to make model behavior understandable to humans, examine predictive models, and assess properties such as reliability, fairness, usability, and trust ( Doshi-Velez and Kim, 2017 ; Biecek and Burzykowski, 2021 ; Ribeiro et al., 2016 ) . Detection therefore needs approaches that characterize GPT-assisted writing through observable linguistic evidence rather than latent neural representations.
blocks.zh: 一项关键的挑战是如何发现由GPT协助的写作,同时提供一层额外证据,供教员在学术廉正调查期间审查。 不当行为决定可能影响职等和纪律行动。 这种决定需要解释,教官和审查委员会可以审查,而不是审查内部证据无法审查的专利模型的不透明的预测分数。 可解释的人工智能文献框架解释是让模型行为为人类所理解,检查预测模型,并评估可靠性,公平性,可用性和信任等属性的一种方法(Doshi-Velez and Kim,2017;Biecek and Burzykowski,2021;Ribeiro等人,2016). 因此,检测需要通过可观察到的语言证据而不是潜在的神经表达来描述GPT辅助写作特征的方法。

blocks.en: Stylometry provides a natural foundation for such an approach. Rather than modeling semantic content, stylometric analysis measures writing through characteristics such as lexical diversity, vocabulary richness, grammatical composition, and sentence structure. Stylometry has a long history in authorship attribution, including the work of Mosteller et al. (1964) and subsequent extensions through stylistic distance measures ( Burrows, 2002 ) , authorship verification methods ( Koppel and Schler, 2004 ) , and function-word classification approaches ( Koppel et al., 2002 ) . Computational linguistics and stylometry have also studied measures of lexical richness and vocabulary diversity ( Tweedie and Baayen, 1998 ; McCarthy and Jarvis, 2010 ) .
blocks.zh: 造型学为这种方法提供了自然的基础. 与其对语义内容进行建模,还不如通过词典多样性,词汇丰富,语法组成,句子结构等特征进行定型分析测量书写. 造型学在作者归属方面有着悠久的历史,包括Mosteller等人(1964年)的作品,以及后来通过定型距离测量法的扩展(Burrows,2002年),作者身份验证方法(Koppel和Schler,2004年),函数词分类方法(Koppel等人,2002年). 计算语言学和语法学也研究了词汇丰富的度量和词汇多样性(Tweedie and Baayen,1998;McCarthy and Jarvis,2010).

blocks.en: Despite extensive research on AI text detection, prior work has given relatively little attention to whether a compact set of interpretable stylometric features extracted from the final submitted text alone could provide sufficient evidence for detection. This study investigates that question, focusing on text-intrinsic evidence that can be applied retrospectively without access to the writing process. The following are the main contributions:
blocks.zh: 尽管对AI文本检测进行了广泛的研究,但以前的工作相对较少注意从最后提交的文本中抽取的一套可解释的紧凑型态特征是否能够为检测提供足够的证据。 这项研究调查了这个问题,重点是可以追溯使用而不能够进入写作过程的文字内涵证据. 以下是主要贡献:

blocks.en:
• We investigate whether a set of interpretable stylometric features extracted from submitted text can distinguish GPT-assisted writing from independently authored student writing. • We propose a sliding window-based protocol (250-word windows with a 125-word stride) to reduce the impact of document length on the extracted features, along with disjoint sets of users across the training and testing partitions to prevent data leakage and evaluate performance on unseen users. • We systematically evaluate eight machine learning classifiers using ROC-AUC, F1, False Positive, and False Negative rates. Window-level probabilities are aggregated into document-level decisions using a pre-specified median-probability rule. • We examine the interpretability of Random Forest, which ranked first
during training-data validation, using SHAP analysis to identify the
stylometric features that contribute most strongly to its predictions.

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section 2 reviews prior research on AI-generated text detection and stylometric analysis. Section 3 describes the dataset, stylometric feature extraction process, machine learning models, and experimental methodology. Section 4 presents the empirical results, statistical analyses, and SHAP-based interpretation of Random Forest. Section 5 discusses ethical considerations and limitations. Finally, Section 6 summarizes the main findings and outlines directions for future research.
blocks.zh: 本文件的其余部分编排如下。 第2节回顾了以前对AI生成的文本检测和定型分析的研究. 第3节描述了数据集,定型特征提取过程,机器学习模型,以及实验方法. 第4节介绍了经验结果、统计分析和基于SHAP的随机森林解释。 第5节讨论了道德因素和局限性。 最后,第6节概述了主要调查结果,并概述了今后研究的方向。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the proposed detection framework. Stylometric features are extracted from fixed-length sliding windows, with disjoint sets of users used for training and testing. Hyperparameters are selected through cross-validation on the training set, and window-level predictions are aggregated using the median to obtain the final document-level classification.
blocks.zh: 图1:拟议检测框架概览。 从固定长度的滑动窗口中提取了定型特性,在培训和测试中使用了脱节的用户组. 超参数通过在训练集上的交叉验证来选择,窗口级预测使用中位数进行汇总以获得最终文件级分类.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Existing detection approaches primarily infer authorship from statistical regularities learned by language models or introduced during text generation. DetectGPT, for example, exploits the observation that machine-generated text tends to occupy regions of negative probability curvature, enabling zero-shot detection without additional training ( Mitchell et al., 2023 ) . Watermarking methods alter the generation process by embedding detectable signatures into token selection ( Kirchenbauer et al., 2023 ) . Although these approaches offer reasonable evidence, they rely on proprietary models, access to generation probabilities, or high-dimensional neural representations that often give limited insight into the evidence supporting individual predictions. Recent studies have further reported reduced robustness under recursive paraphrasing ( Sadasivan et al., 2023 ) and stylistic or text-complexity variation ( Doughman et al., 2024 ) , as well as systematic biases against non-native English writers ( Liang et al., 2023 ) , which raise concerns about detector use in high-stakes educational settings.
blocks.zh: 现有的检测方法主要推断出语言模型所学或文本生成期间引入的统计规律的作者身份. 例如,DetectGPT利用了一种观察,即机器生成的文本往往占据负概率曲率的区域,使得零发探测无需额外训练(Mitchell等人,2023年)。 水印方法改变生成过程,将可探测的签名嵌入到符号选择中(Kirchenbauer等人,2023年)。 尽管这些方法提供了合理的证据,但它们依赖于专有模型,获取生成概率,或高维神经表达,这些表达往往能对支持个人预测的证据产生有限的洞察力. 最近的研究还报告,在递归性抛射(Sadasivan等人,2023年)和文体或文字复杂性变异(Doughman等人,2024年)下,稳健性降低,对非本土英语作家的系统性偏见(Liang等人,2023年),这引起了对高考教育环境中检测器用途的关切。

blocks.en: Parallel research has shifted focus from the submitted document to the writing process. Keystroke dynamics captures observable behavioral signals, including typing speed, pauses, revisions, and temporal writing patterns, that can differ between independently authored and GPT-assisted writing ( Kundu et al., 2024 ; Roh et al., 2025 ; Mehta et al., 2026 ) . However, behavioral approaches require instrumented writing environments and therefore do not apply retrospectively to submitted assignments or existing document collections.
blocks.zh: 平行研究已将重点从提交的文件转移到编写进程。 Keystroke动态捕捉到可观察到的行为信号,包括打字速度,暂停,修改,以及时间写法模式,这些信号可以区别于独立作者和GPT辅助写法(Kundu等人,2024年;Roh等人,2025年;Mehta等人,2026年). 然而,行为方法要求有仪表书写环境,因此不追溯适用于提交的任务或现有文件集.

blocks.en:
Stylometry offers a complementary text-intrinsic perspective based on the hypothesis that writers exhibit lexical and grammatical preferences that remain sufficiently consistent to characterize writing style. Authorship studies show that surface-level lexical and syntactic features carry enough signal to distinguish writers ( Mosteller et al., 1964 ; Burrows, 2002 ; Koppel et al., 2002 ; Koppel and Schler, 2004 ) . Lexical diversity measures and vocabulary richness metrics capture aspects of writing style while remaining directly observable and statistically interpretable ( Tweedie and Baayen, 1998 ; McCarthy and Jarvis, 2010 ) . We also include entropy as an information-theoretic summary of token-frequency dispersion ( Shannon, 1948 ) . Unlike proprietary prediction scores or latent neural embeddings, these features correspond to explicit linguistic characteristics that can be independently examined by educators and academic integrity investigators. While GPT can imitate human writing style, detectable differences may
remain ( Jemama and Kumar, 2025 ) . Another closely related study Safi (2025) used a transparent classification scheme based on word choices and function words to distinguish student responses from ChatGPT responses, and found that lightly edited or style-mimicking AI text remained detectable. We extend this line of work with evaluation on unseen participants, SHAP-based feature-level explanations, and explicit confidence intervals on error rates.
blocks.zh:
造型学提供了一种互补的文本内涵视角,其基础假设是,作家表现出语法和语法上的偏好,这些偏好保持了足够的一致性,足以定性写作风格. 作者研究显示,表层词典和合成特征具有足够的信号,足以区分作家(Mosteller等人,1964年;Burrows,2002年;Koppel等人,2002年;Koppel和Schler,2004年)。 语法多样性计量和词汇丰富度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度 我们还将乙烯作为象征频率分散的信息理论摘要(Shannon,1948年)。 与专有预测分数或潜伏神经嵌入不同,这些特征与教育者和学术诚信调查人员可以独立检查的明显语言特征相对应. 虽然GPT可以模仿人类的写作风格,但可察觉的差异可能

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1 describes the detection framework we implemented and evaluated. We first extract the features listed in Table 1 using a sliding window-based protocol. We then create two disjoint sets of users, one for training the detectors and the other for evaluating their performance. Each detector produces a probability score for each window (sample), and the window-level probabilities are aggregated using a median-probability rule to obtain a document-level score. The document-level scores are then used to classify each document as human-authored or GPT-assisted. The performance of each detector on the test data is evaluated using F1, ROC-AUC, False Positive Rate, and False Negative Rate. Finally, we use SHAP to examine the stylometric features contributing to the predictions of Random Forest.
blocks.zh: 图1介绍了我们实施和评估的检测框架。 我们首先使用一个基于滑动窗口的协议来提取表1中所列的特性. 然后我们创建了两组不相连的用户,一组用于培训探测器,另一组用于评估其性能。 每个探测器为每个窗口(样本)产生概率分数,窗口级概率使用中位概率规则进行汇总,以获得文件级分数. 然后,文档级别分数用于将每个文档归类为人类作者或GPT辅助. 使用F1、ROC-AUC、假阳性率和假阴性率来评价测试数据上每个探测器的性能。 最后,我们用SHAP来检查有助于随机森林预测的时态特征.

blocks.en: Table 1: Stylometric representation used for GPT-assisted writing detection. Each writing sample is represented by nine interpretable lexical, syntactic, and sentence-level features that quantify vocabulary diversity, vocabulary richness, grammatical composition, and sentence-length variation.
blocks.zh: 表1:用于GPT辅助写作检测的定型表示. 每个书写样本由9个可解释的词典,综合,句子层次特征代表,这些特征可以量化词汇多样性,词汇丰富,语法组成,句子长度变化.

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: We use the IIITD-BU (Paraphrased) dataset described by Mehta et al. (2026) . The dataset was collected to examine student writing under independent and GPT-assisted conditions using keystroke dynamics ( Mehta et al., 2026 ) . Participants were primarily students enrolled in a course on Large Language Models at IIIT Delhi, India. They responded to two questions about large language models: one focused on explaining how LLMs work and their applications, while the other asked participants to analyze their strengths and weaknesses in educational settings and propose an improvement.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Mehta等人(2026年)描述的IIITD-BU(解释)数据集。 数据集的收集是为了在独立和GPT协助的条件下使用键盘振动来检查学生的写作(Mehta等人,2026年). 学员主要是印度德里国际技术学院大语文模型课程的学生。 他们回答了关于大型语言模型的两个问题:一个侧重于解释LLMS如何工作及其应用,另一个则要求参与者分析他们在教育环境中的优缺点并提出改进建议.

blocks.en: Participants completed the tasks in two sessions. In the first session, they answered the questions independently using their own knowledge and reasoning. In the second session, they were allowed to use LLMs such as ChatGPT for assistance but were explicitly instructed to paraphrase the generated content before typing their responses. Copy-and-paste functionality was disabled, as were auto-correct, grammar tools, and browser extensions. Thus, in this study, “GPT-assisted” refers specifically to responses written by paraphrasing GPT-generated content rather than to the broader range of possible GPT-assisted writing practices.
blocks.zh: 学员们分两期完成了任务。 在第一场比赛中,他们用自己的知识和推理独立地回答了问题. 在第二场会上,他们被允许使用ChatGPT等LLMs作为援助,但被明确指示在输入他们的答复之前解释生成的内容。 复制和粘贴功能被禁用,自动校正、语法工具和浏览器扩展功能也被禁用。 因此,在本研究中,“GPT协助”具体是指通过对GPT生成的内容进行解释而写出的答复,而不是更广泛的GPT协助编写的做法。

blocks.en:
Although the original study collected keystroke dynamics and interaction traces, we focus exclusively on the final submitted text. We make this choice deliberately because our objective is to determine whether interpretable stylometric features extracted directly from submitted text contain sufficient signal to distinguish the two writing conditions without
behavioral information, which may be unavailable in retrospective academic integrity investigations.
blocks.zh:
虽然最初的研究收集了按键动力学和相互作用的痕迹,但我们只关注最后提交的文本。 我们作出这一选择是故意的,因为我们的目标是确定直接从提交的文本中提取的可解释性定型特征是否包含足够的信号,以区分两个写法条件,而不包含
行为信息,在学术诚信追溯调查中可能无法获得.

blocks.en:
Each participant completed two prompts in each session. We concatenate the two responses from the same session to form a single response for each participant under each writing condition. The resulting dataset contains 180 180 writing samples from 90 participants, with each participant contributing one independently authored response and one GPT-assisted response. The
dataset is therefore balanced across the two writing conditions.
blocks.zh:
每位学员在每届会议上完成了两次提示。 我们合并了同一届会议的两份答复,以便在每个写作条件下为每个参加者形成一个单一的答复。 由此产生的数据集包含来自90个参与者的180个写作样本,每个参与者提供一份独立撰写的回复和一份伽马--普陀辅助回复。 那个
因此,数据集在两个写入条件之间是平衡的。

blocks.en: Independently authored responses contained an average of 620 620 whitespace-delimited words (SD = 198 198 ), compared with 515 515 words (SD = 155 155 ) for GPT-assisted responses. The corresponding mean sentence counts were 26.5 26.5 and 24.7 24.7 , while mean sentence lengths were 27.2 27.2 and 27.3 27.3 words, respectively. Because differences in document length could influence some stylometric features, particularly lexical-diversity measures, Section 4 explicitly examines these differences and whether document length alone can explain the observed classification performance.
blocks.zh: 独立撰写的回复中平均包含620,620个白空间限词(SD=198,198),而GPT协助的回复中则包含515,515个单词(SD=155,155). 相应的平均句数为26.526.5和24.724.7,平均句数分别为27.227.2和27.327.3。 由于文件长度的差异可能影响某些时态特征,特别是词典多样性措施,第4节明确审查了这些差异以及文件长度本身能否解释观察到的分类性能.

blocks.en: Because every participant appears in both conditions, a naive random split could place a participant’s independently authored and ChatGPT-assisted texts on opposite sides of the split, allowing author-specific writing style to leak between training and evaluation and potentially inflating performance. To prevent this, we use disjoint sets of users for training and evaluation, with all texts from a given participant kept in the same set. The 90 90 participants were partitioned into 72 72 training participants ( 144 144 samples) and 18 18 held-out participants ( 36 36 samples: 18 18 independently authored and 18 18 ChatGPT-assisted), with no participant shared between the two sets.
blocks.zh: 由于每个参与者都出现在两种情况下,天真随机的分裂可能会将参与者独立撰写的和ChatGPT协助的文本放置在分裂的对立面,让作者特有的写作风格在培训和评价之间泄露出来,并可能夸大表现. 为了防止这种情况,我们使用不相连的用户组进行培训和评价,特定参与者的所有文本都保留在同一组。 90名参与者被分为72名72名培训参与者(144个样本)和18名被搁置的参与者(36个样本:18个独立撰写的样本和18个ChatGPT协助的样本),没有参与者在两组之间共享.

blocks.en: 3.2 Preprocessing and feature engineering
blocks.zh: 3.2 预处理和特性工程

blocks.en: We extracted the final text from each response and removed residual keyboard-event tokens from the original keystroke-logging instrumentation, including Control and CapsLock . We split each cleaned document into whitespace-delimited words and generated windows using a pre-specified length of 250 250 words and a stride of 125 125 words, resulting in 50 % 50\% overlap between adjacent windows. We right-aligned the final window to the end of the document so that no text was discarded, and no artificial padding was added. Documents shorter than 250 words contributed one full-document window.
blocks.zh: 我们从每个响应中提取了最终文本,并移除了原始键盘-博客仪表中的剩余键盘-事件符号,包括Control和CapsLock. 我们用预先指定的长度250个字和125个125个字的脚步将每个清理过的文档分割成白空限定字,并生成窗口,导致相邻窗口之间50%的50QQ重叠. 我们把最后的窗口与文件的结尾对齐,这样就不会丢弃文本,也不会增加人为的粘贴。 少于250字的文件提供了一个完整的文件窗口。

blocks.en: This procedure produced 722 722 windows, including 397 397 independently authored windows and 325 325 GPT-assisted windows. The 72 72 training participants contributed 595 windows, while the 18 18 held-out participants contributed 127 127 windows from 36 36 documents, including 74 74 independently authored and 53 53 GPT-assisted windows. Windowing increases the number of text segments available to the classifiers, but these windows are not additional independent participants. Therefore, we kept all windows from a given participant within the same training, validation, or test set throughout the analysis.
blocks.zh: 这一程序产生了722,722个窗口,包括397,397个独立撰写的窗口和325个GPT辅助窗口. 72名培训参与者贡献了595个窗口,而18名被搁置的18名参与者贡献了来自36个文件的127 127个窗口,其中包括74个独立撰写的窗口和53个GPT辅助窗口. 窗口会增加分类器可用的文本段数,但这些窗口并不是额外的独立参与者. 因此,在整个分析过程中,我们把对特定参与者的所有窗口都保留在同一培训、验证或测试装置内。

blocks.en: We tokenized each window using quanteda with punctuation removed and obtained part-of-speech annotations using the udpipe English EWT model ( english-ewt-ud-2.5 ). The Non-stopword Ratio used the 175-word Snowball English stop list. Stop-list matching was case-folded, while Type-Token Ratio, Hapax Ratio, and Word Entropy preserved case. We segmented sentences at sentence-final periods for Sentence-Length Variability. We computed the nine features independently for each window and centered and scaled them using parameters estimated from the training data only. All analyses used R 4.4.3 with fastml (0.7.8), quanteda (4.3.1), and udpipe (0.8.16). A fixed random seed (123) was used for the user split, cross-validation folds, and Bayesian tuning.
blocks.zh: 我们用四分法对每个窗口进行标记,去掉点缀,并使用Udpipe English EWT(英语:English-ewt-ud-2.5)模型获得部分语音说明。 "不停止字比"使用了175字的雪球英式停站名单. stop- list 匹配是大小写文件夹, 而 Type-Token 比率、 Hapax 比率和 Word Entropy 则保留了大小写 。 我们在判决的终审阶段 将判决分割开来 我们独立计算了每个窗口的9个特性,并仅利用培训数据估计的参数将其集中和缩放。 所有分析都使用含快餐剂(0.7.8)的4.4.3R(4.3.1)和水管(0.8.16)。 使用固定的随机种子(123)用于用户拆分,交叉验证折叠,以及贝叶斯调音.

blocks.en: Each window received a predicted probability of GPT assistance. We aggregated these probabilities using the median to obtain a document-level score. Using a pre-specified threshold of 0.50 0.50 , we classified a document as GPT-assisted when its median probability was at least 0.50 0.50 . The median reduces the influence of an unusually high or low window while retaining the probability information that would be lost with hard majority voting.
blocks.zh: 每个窗口都收到了预计的GPT援助概率. 我们用中位数来汇总这些概率,以获得文件级别的分数。 使用预先指定的0.50 0.50的阈值,当一个文件的中位概率至少为0.50 0.50时,我们将其归类为GPT辅助. 中位数减少了异常高或低窗口的影响,同时保留了在硬多数表决后丢失的概率信息.

blocks.en: 3.3 Feature analysis
blocks.zh: 3.3 特征分析

blocks.en: We analyzed the nine stylometric features to examine how they differ between independently authored and GPT-assisted writing. Because overlapping windows from the same document are not statistically independent, for this analysis we first summarized each feature by its median across the windows of each document. We then used paired t t -tests to compare each feature between the two writing conditions across the 90 90 participants. We also computed point-biserial correlations ( r r ) to measure the association between each feature and the writing condition.
blocks.zh: 我们分析了9个定型特征,以研究它们如何区别独立作者和GPT辅助的写作. 由于同一文件的重叠窗口在统计学上并不独立,因此,在进行这一分析时,我们首先用每个文件窗口的中位数来概括每个特征。 然后,我们用配对 t - t 测试来比较90名参与者在两个写作条件中的每个特征. 我们还计算了点-二元关系(r r),以衡量每个特性与写条件之间的联系。

blocks.en: Table 2: Mean document-level median feature values for independently authored and GPT-assisted writing across 90 participants. Paired t t -tests compare the two writing conditions, and positive r r indicates higher values in GPT-assisted writing.
blocks.zh: 表2:90名参与者中,独立撰写和GPT协助编写的平均文件级别中位特征值。 Paired t - t - tests 比较了两个写作条件,正值 r 表示GPT辅助写作值较高.

blocks.en: 3.4 Classifier training and validation
blocks.zh: 3.4 分类培训和鉴定

blocks.en: We evaluated Logistic Regression, Linear Discriminant Analysis, Quadratic Discriminant Analysis, Naive Bayes, Random Forest, linear Support Vector Machine, k k -Nearest Neighbors, and a multilayer perceptron. These classifiers were selected because they represent different learning paradigms, including linear and discriminant models, probabilistic methods, instance-based learning, ensemble learning, margin-based classification, and neural networks. They are also commonly used in text classification and related stylometric classification tasks. Evaluating this diverse set of classifiers allows us to examine whether the proposed stylometric features are useful across different modeling approaches rather than being specific to a single classifier.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了逻辑回归,线性差异分析,四面体差异分析,Naive Bayes, Random Forest, 线性支持矢量机, k - Nearest nearbors, 以及多层感官. 这些分类法之所以被选中,是因为它们代表了不同的学习范式,包括线性模型和歧视性模型,概率学方法,基于实例的学习,综艺的学习,基于比值的分类,以及神经网络. 它们也常用于文本分类及相关的定型分类任务中. 评估这组不同的分类方法,使我们能够审查提议的型式特征在不同的建模方法中是否有用,而不是专门针对单一的分类方法。

blocks.en: Hyperparameter tuning was performed using only the training partition through Bayesian optimization with 30 iterations over the default fastml search space for each classifier. During validation, all windows and both writing conditions from a given participant were kept in the same fold. We compared the eight classifiers using mean validation ROC-AUC under repeated 10 10 -fold validation and an additional 5-by-5 nested-validation check. Random Forest ranked first under both validation procedures. The final Random Forest used three candidate features at each split, 500 500 trees, and a minimum node size of 10 10 .
blocks.zh: 进行超参数调试时,只使用通过巴耶西亚优化的训练分区,每个分类器的默认快件搜索空间有30个迭代。 在验证过程中,特定参与者的所有窗口和写作条件都保持同一折叠. 我们在重复的10个10倍验证和额外的5乘以5的巢验证检查下,使用平均验证ROC-AUC对8个分类进行了比较。 随机森林在两种验证程序下排名第一. 最终的随机森林使用三个候选特征 每一块,500棵树,和最小的节点大小 10 10...

blocks.en: After tuning, each classifier was fit to the complete training partition and evaluated once on the held-out test set. The held-out test set was not used for hyperparameter tuning or model selection.
blocks.zh: 调试后,每个分类器都适合完整的训练分区,并在停放测试集上评价一次. 搁置的测试集没有用于超参数调制或模型选择。

blocks.en: 3.5 Evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 3.5 评价尺度

blocks.en:
We treat GPT-assisted writing as the positive class and independently authored writing as the negative class. We use ROC-AUC and F1-score as the principal performance measures. ROC-AUC measures how well the document-level probabilities rank GPT-assisted texts above independently authored texts across different thresholds. F1 summarizes the balance between precision
and recall for detecting GPT-assisted writing.
blocks.zh:
我们把GPT辅助写作视为正类,将独立作者写作视为负类. 我们使用ROC-AUC和F1-分数作为主要业绩计量。 ROC-AUC衡量文件级别的概率将GPT辅助文本置于不同阈值的独立作者文本之上的程度。 F1总结了精确度之间的平衡
用于检测 GPT 辅助写作。

blocks.en: We also report the False Positive Rate (FPR) and False Negative Rate (FNR). A false positive occurs when independently authored writing is incorrectly classified as GPT-assisted, while a false negative occurs when GPT-assisted writing is incorrectly classified as independently authored. We report both errors as counts, rates, and 95% Wilson confidence intervals.
blocks.zh: 我们还报告假正率和假负率。 当独立作者的写作被错误地归类为GPT辅助时会出现假阳性,而GPT辅助写作被错误地归类为独立作者时则会出现假阴性. 我们报告两个错误 计数,率, 和95%的威尔逊信任间隔。

blocks.en: 3.6 Interpretability framework
blocks.zh: 3.6 可解释性框架

blocks.en: We used SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to examine how each feature contributes to the Random Forest predictions. Random Forest was selected for the interpretability analysis based on its performance during training-data validation rather than its performance on the held-out test set. Global SHAP importance summarizes the mean absolute contribution of each feature across the held-out windows. The beeswarm plot shows the direction and magnitude of each window-level contribution together with the corresponding feature value.
blocks.zh: 我们用Shapley Additive ex Planations(SHAP)来研究每个特征如何促进随机森林预测。 " 随机森林 " 是根据其在培训数据验证中的表现,而不是根据在搁置测试中的表现,被选作可解释性分析。 全球SHAP的重要性总结了每个功能在整个被搁置窗口中的平均绝对贡献. 蜂蜜图显示了每个窗口级贡献的方向和规模以及相应的特征值.

blocks.en:
Because the final document score is the median of its window probabilities, for the local examples we explain the window with a probability closest to the document median. These examples therefore show how the features contribute to the prediction for a representative window of the document rather than providing an explanation of the entire multi-window
aggregation.
blocks.zh:
因为最终文档得分是其窗口概率的中位数,所以对于本地实例,我们用最接近文档中位数的概率来解释窗口. 因此,这些例子表明,这些特征有助于预测文件的代表性窗口,而不是解释整个多窗口。
汇总。

blocks.en: 4 Results and discussion
blocks.zh: 4. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: 4.1 Detection performance
blocks.zh: 4.1 探测性能

blocks.en:
Figure 2 shows the cross-validation results used to compare the eight classifiers on the training data. Random Forest achieved the highest mean validation ROC-AUC ( 0.838 0.838 ), followed closely by Naive Bayes, QDA, LDA, Logistic Regression, and linear SVM. The error bars show substantial overlap, indicating similar validation performance
among these classifiers. Random Forest also ranked first in the additional nested-validation check and was therefore selected for the subsequent interpretability analysis.
blocks.zh:
图2显示用于在培训数据上比较8个分类器的交叉验证结果。 随机森林实现了最高的平均值验证ROC-AUC(0.838 0.838 ),紧随其后的是Naive Bayes,QDA,LDA,Logistic Reression,以及线性SVM. 错误条显示大量重叠, 显示类似的验证性能
在这些分类中。 随机森林在附加的巢验证检查中也排名第一,因此被选入后续的可解释性分析.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Comparison of the eight classifiers using repeated 10-fold cross-validation on the training data, with all data from the same participant kept in the same fold. Points show mean validation ROC-AUC, and error bars show one standard deviation.
blocks.zh: 图2:使用重复的10倍交叉验证对培训数据进行8个分类的比较,同一参与者的所有数据都保持同一折叠。 点显示平均值验证 ROC-AUC,错误栏显示一个标准偏差.

blocks.en:
The classifier comparison and hyperparameter tuning used only the training data, and the held-out test set played no role in these decisions. Final evaluation was performed on 36 documents from 18 held-out participants, using the median of the window-level probabilities to obtain a score for each document. Random Forest achieved a holdout ROC-AUC of 0.870 0.870 (95% CI: 0.747 0.747 – 0.981 0.981 ) and an F1-score of 0.842 0.842 (95% CI: 0.737 0.737 – 0.944 0.944 ). Confidence intervals were estimated using
participant-level bootstrap resampling.
blocks.zh:
分类器的比较和超参数调试只使用了培训数据,停用测试集在这些决定中没有起到作用. 对来自18个被搁置参与者的36份文件进行了最后评价,利用窗口级概率的中位数为每份文件获得一个分数。 随机森林实现了0.870 0.870的坚守ROC-AUC(95%的CI:0.747 0.747 – 0.981 0.981)和0.842 0.842的F1分(95%的CI:0.737 0.737 – 0.944 0.944)。 使用
参与者级的靴子带重新取样 。

blocks.en: Table 3: Random Forest performance on 36 held-out documents from 18 unseen participants. GPT-assisted writing is treated as the positive class.
blocks.zh: 表3:来自18个未见参与者的36份搁置文件中的随机森林业绩。 GPT辅助写作被视作正类.

blocks.en: Table 4: Document-level confusion matrix for Random Forest on the 36 held-out documents using the median window-probability rule.
blocks.zh: 表4:使用中位窗口概率规则对36个被搁置文件的随机森林的文档级别混淆矩阵.

blocks.en: With GPT-assisted writing treated as the positive class, four independently authored documents were incorrectly classified as GPT-assisted, resulting in a False Positive Rate of 4 / 18 = 22.2 % 4/18=22.2\% (95% Wilson CI: 9.0 % 9.0\% – 45.2 % 45.2\% ). Two GPT-assisted documents were incorrectly classified as independently authored, resulting in a False Negative Rate of 2 / 18 = 11.1 % 2/18=11.1\% (95% Wilson CI: 3.1 % 3.1\% – 32.8 % 32.8\% ). The false positives are particularly important in an academic integrity setting because they represent independently authored work incorrectly flagged as GPT-assisted. Both confidence intervals are wide, reflecting the small held-out sample, and these results do not support using the model as standalone evidence for academic misconduct.
blocks.zh: 由于GPT辅助写作被视作正文类,4份独立撰写的文件被错误地归类为GPT辅助写作,导致4/18=22.2 % 4/18=22.2 \%(95% Wilson CI:9.0 % – 45.2 % 45.2 \% ) 。 2份GPT辅助写作文件被错误地归类为独立撰写,导致2/18=11.1 % (95% Wilson CI: 3.1% 3.1+= 32.8 % 32.8\% ) 。 在学术诚信环境下,错误的正面写作尤为重要,因为它们代表了独立撰写的GPT辅助写作。 两种信任间隔都很宽,反映了被搁置的少量样本,这些结果不支持将该模型作为学术不当行为的独立证据。

blocks.en:
As a post-hoc sensitivity analysis, we conducted
additional experiments using five train-test ratios
ranging from 60/40 to 80/20. As shown in Table 5 ,
the mean False Positive Rate ranged from 12.4 % 12.4\% to 15.8 % 15.8\% , while the mean False Negative
Rate ranged from 23.7 % 23.7\% to 24.8 % 24.8\% . Although the mean error rates remained relatively
stable across the evaluated train-test ratios,
the class-specific estimates differed from those
obtained on the original held-out test set.
This variation highlights the uncertainty associated
with evaluation on a single small test set.

blocks.en: 4.2 Error analysis
blocks.zh: 4.2 错误分析

blocks.en: The median-probability rule misclassified six of the 36 held-out documents. Four independently authored documents received median GPT-assisted probabilities ranging from 0.636 0.636 to 0.920 0.920 and were therefore false positives. Two GPT-assisted documents were false negatives. One was close to the decision threshold, with a median GPT-assisted probability of 0.495 0.495 , while the other received a substantially lower probability of 0.151 0.151 . These errors show that the median aggregation reduces the influence of unusually high or low window probabilities but does not eliminate overlap between independently authored and GPT-assisted writing. The results further support using the model as a decision-support tool requiring contextual review rather than as standalone evidence of academic misconduct.
blocks.zh: 中度概率规则对36份搁置文件中的6份进行了错误分类。 4份独立撰写的文件获得的GPT辅助概率中位数从0.636 0.636到0.920 0.920不等,因此为假阳性. 两份GPT辅助文件为假底片. 其中一个接近决定阈值,GPT协助的中位概率为0.495 0.495,而另一个得到的概率为0.151 0.151. 这些错误表明,中位聚合降低了异常高或低窗口概率的影响,但并没有消除独立作者和GPT辅助写作之间的重叠. 结果进一步支持将该模式用作需要背景审查的决策支助工具,而不是学术不当行为的独立证据。

blocks.en: 4.3 Length and feature controls
blocks.zh: 4.3 长度和特性控制

blocks.en:
Our sliding-window design standardizes the amount of text used to compute the stylometric features while also producing multiple samples from each document. Each document was divided into 250-word windows with a 125-word stride, and the nine features were computed separately for each window. Thus, for most samples, features such as Type-Token Ratio and Hapax Ratio are computed from the same number of words rather than from complete documents of different lengths. Of the 722 windows, 508 contained 250 words. The remaining 214 came from documents shorter than 250 words and
were retained without padding.
blocks.zh:
我们的滑窗设计将用来计算样式特征的文本数量标准化,同时从每个文档中生成多个样本。 每个文件被分为250字窗口,并采用125字步法,每个窗口分别计算9个功能. 因此,对于大多数样本来说,诸如Type-Token比率和Hapax比率等特征都是从相同数目的单词而不是从长度不同的完整文件中计算的。 在722个窗口中,508个包含250个字. 其余214个来自少于250字的文件;
保留了下来,没有铺垫。

blocks.en: We nevertheless examined document length because the original documents differed between the two writing conditions. Independently authored documents contained more words than GPT-assisted documents (paired t ⁡ ( 89 ) = 6.46 t(89)=6.46 , p < .001 p<.001 ; Welch p < .001 p<.001 ), with independently authored documents being longer in 72 of the 90 pairs. In contrast, sentence count and mean sentence length did not differ significantly between the two conditions (paired p = .051 p=.051 and p = .97 p=.97 , respectively).
blocks.zh: 然而,我们审查了文件长度,因为原始文件在两种书面条件之间有所不同。 独立撰写的文件包含的字数多于GPT辅助文件(paired t ⁡ (89) = 6.46 t (89) = 6.46, p < 001 p < 001; Welch p < 001 p < 001)),独立撰写的文件在90对文件中的72对更长. 相比之下,句子计数和平均句子长度在这两个条件之间没有明显差异(分别为paired p=.051 p=.051和p=.97 p=.97).

blocks.en: As an additional control, a classifier using only the total document word count achieved a cross-validation ROC-AUC of 0.68 0.68 , showing that document length itself contains some information about the writing condition. However, total document word count is not used as a feature in our main classifier, and the fixed-word windowing design largely prevents the stylometric features from directly capturing differences in overall document length. Replacing Type-Token Ratio and Hapax Ratio with moving-average TTR produced an ROC-AUC close to that of the full model. Feature-group ablations further showed that lexical features carried most of the discriminative signal, followed by part-of-speech features, while Sentence-Length Variability alone performed near chance.
blocks.zh: 作为附加控件,只使用总文档字数的分类器实现了0.68 0.68 的交叉验证ROC-AUC,显示文档长度本身包含一些关于写入条件的信息. 然而,在我们的主分类器中,总文档单词计数不作为特征,固定词窗口设计在很大程度上阻止了时态特征直接捕捉整个文档长度的差异. 以移动平均TTR取代Type-Token比和Hapax比,产生了一个接近全模型的ROC-AUC. 地貌组合浮雕进一步表明,词典特征承载了大多数的区别信号,之后是部分语义特征,而Priment-Length Variability单是表现了近乎偶然.

blocks.en: 4.4 Feature differences
blocks.zh: 4.4 特征差异

blocks.en: Table 2 shows significant differences in several stylometric features between independently authored and GPT-assisted writing. GPT-assisted documents have higher TTR, Hapax Ratio, Word Entropy, NSR, Noun Ratio, Verb Ratio, and Adjective Ratio, while independently authored documents have higher Adverb Ratio and Sentence-Length Variability. NSR and Noun Ratio show the strongest positive associations with GPT-assisted writing, while Adverb Ratio shows the strongest negative association. For these statistical comparisons, each feature was summarized by its median across the windows of each document, preventing overlapping windows from inflating the inferential sample size.
blocks.zh: 表2显示独立作者与GPT辅助写作在几个时态特征上存在显著差异. GPT辅助文档具有较高的TTR,Hapax比,Word Entropy,NSR,名词比,Verb比,以及形容比,而独立作者文档具有较高的Adverb比和句子-Length Variable. NSR和名词比显示了GPT辅助写作的最强阳性关联,而Adverb比显示了最强阴性关联. 就这些统计比较而言,每个特征按每一文件窗口的中位数加以汇总,防止窗口重叠夸大引申样本大小。

blocks.en: 4.5 SHAP analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5 SHAP分析

blocks.en:
Figure 3 shows the global Random Forest SHAP
importance. Hapax Ratio is the most influential feature, followed by NSR, Noun Ratio, Adverb Ratio, and TTR. Verb Ratio, Sentence-Length Variability, and Word Entropy have smaller contributions, while Adjective Ratio contributes least. Figure 4 shows that the direction and magnitude of these contributions vary across windows, reflecting the non-linear relationships learned by Random Forest.
blocks.zh:
图3显示全球随机森林特别行动计划
重要性。 Hapax比率是最有影响力的特征,其次是NSR,名词比率,副词比率和TTR. Verb比率,句子-Length可变性,和Word Entropy的贡献较小,而形容比率的贡献最小. 图4显示,这些贡献的方向和规模因窗口而异,反映了Random Forest学到的非线性关系。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Global Random Forest SHAP importance across held-out windows. Higher mean absolute SHAP values indicate greater influence on the predicted probability of GPT-assisted writing.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Random Forest SHAP summary across held-out windows. Horizontal position shows the contribution to the predicted probability of GPT-assisted writing, and color indicates the corresponding feature value.
blocks.zh: 图4:跨搁置窗口的随机森林特别行动计划摘要。 水平位置显示对GPT辅助写作的预测概率的贡献,颜色表示相应的特征值.

blocks.en:
For the GPT-assisted example, the selected window has a predicted
probability of 0.947 0.947 , with NSR and Hapax Ratio making the largest positive contributions. For the independently authored example, the selected window has a predicted probability of 0.077 0.077 , with Hapax Ratio, Noun Ratio, NSR, and TTR shifting the prediction toward independently authored writing. These examples show how observable stylometric features contribute to individual window predictions. They do not explain the entire multi-window aggregation or establish that a prediction is valid evidence of misconduct.
blocks.zh:
对于GPT 辅助示例,选定的窗口有一个预测
概率为0.947 0.947,其中NSR和Hapax比率贡献最大。 对于独立作者的例子,所选窗口的预测概率为0.077 0.077 ,其中Hapax比率,名词比率,NSR,以及TTR将预测转向独立作者写入. 这些例子显示了可观测的时态特征如何有助于单个窗口预测. 它们没有解释整个多窗口汇总,也没有确定预测是不当行为的有效证据。

blocks.en: 5 Ethical considerations and limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 道德考虑和限制

blocks.en: GPT-assisted writing detection may influence grades and disciplinary actions. Detection systems should therefore be used as decision-support tools rather than definitive evidence of misconduct. A prediction should initiate contextual review and should not replace an instructor’s assessment, student testimony, or institutional due process.
blocks.zh: GPT协助的写作检测可能影响等级和纪律行动. 因此,侦查系统应用作决策支助工具,而不是不当行为的确凿证据。 预测应启动背景审查,不应取代教员的评估、学生证词或机构正当程序。

blocks.en:
False positives are particularly important because they represent
independently authored work incorrectly classified as GPT-assisted. In our held-out evaluation, the False Positive Rate was 22.2 % 22.2\% ( 4 / 18 4/18 ), with a 95% confidence interval of 9.0 % 9.0\% – 45.2 % 45.2\% . The wide interval reflects the small test set and does not support automated use. SHAP can explain which features contributed to a prediction, but it does not establish that the prediction is reliable or fair.
blocks.zh:
假阳性特别重要,因为它们代表
独立作者的作品被错误地归类为GPT辅助. 在被搁置的评价中,伪正率是22.2%(4 / 18 4/18),95%的置信间隔是9.0%(9.0) — — 45.2%(45.2)。 宽间隔反映了小的测试集,不支持自动化使用. SHAP可以解释哪些特征有助于预测,但并不能确定预测是可靠或公平的.

blocks.en: Several limitations bound our findings. The study uses 90 participants from one course, institution, topic area, and GPT-assistance setting. In this dataset, participants used GPT-generated content and were instructed to paraphrase it before typing their responses. Other forms of AI assistance, such as brainstorming or editing, were not evaluated. The results also do not establish performance across other assignments, disciplines, institutions, languages, student populations, or LLMs. Because all participants completed the independent session first, the writing condition may also be affected by session order. External validation is therefore necessary.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果受到若干限制。 这项研究利用了来自一个课程、机构、主题领域和普通教育援助的90名参与者。 在这个数据集中,参与者使用GPT生成的内容,并被指示在输入其回复前进行解释. 对大赦国际的其他形式的援助,例如集思广益或编辑,没有进行评价。 其结果也没有确定其他任务、学科、机构、语言、学生群体或法学硕士课程的业绩。 由于所有参与者先完成独立的会话,写作条件也可能受到会话顺序的影响. 因此,外部验证是必要的。

blocks.en: Finally, we did not evaluate performance across demographic or language background groups and therefore cannot draw conclusions about fairness across these groups. Writing styles and GPT outputs may also change over time, and the stylometric features may be deliberately altered. Evaluation on new populations and writing conditions is needed before institutional use.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们没有评估各个人口或语言背景群体的业绩,因此无法就这些群体的公平性得出结论。 写作风格和GPT输出也可能随时间而变化,时态特征也可能被故意改变. 在机构使用之前,需要对新的人口和写作条件进行评价。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and future work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
This study evaluated an interpretable stylometric approach for
distinguishing GPT-assisted and independently authored student writing. Documents were divided into overlapping 250-word windows, and all data from the same participant were kept in the same training, validation, or test set. Eight classifiers were compared using the training data, with Random Forest achieving the highest validation ROC-AUC. Window-level probabilities were then combined using their median to obtain the final document-level prediction.
blocks.zh:
这项研究评估了一种可解释的型式方法。
区分由GPT协助和独立撰写的学生写作。 文件分为重叠的250字窗口,同一参与者的所有数据都保存在同一培训、验证或测试集中。 利用培训数据对8个分类人员进行了比较,Random Forest实现了ROC-AUC的最高验证。 然后用其中位数合并窗口级概率,以获得最终文件级的预测。

blocks.en: On 36 held-out documents, Random Forest achieved an ROC-AUC of 0.870 0.870 and an F1-score of 0.842 0.842 . Four independently authored documents were incorrectly classified as GPT-assisted, while two GPT-assisted documents were incorrectly classified as independently authored. SHAP identified Hapax Ratio, NSR, Noun Ratio, Adverb Ratio, and TTR as the most influential features. These results show that interpretable stylometric features provide useful signal for distinguishing the two writing conditions. However, the small test set, observed errors, and wide confidence intervals do not support using the model as standalone evidence of academic misconduct.
blocks.zh: 在36份被搁置的文件中,Random Forest取得了0.870 0.870的ROC-AUC和0.842 0.842的F1-分数. 四份独立作者文件被错误地归类为GPT辅助文件,而两份GPT辅助文件被错误地归类为独立作者. SHAP将哈帕克斯比,NSR,名词比,副词比,TTR确定为最具影响力的特征. 这些结果表明,可解释的时态特征为区分两个写作条件提供了有用的信号. 然而,小规模的测试、观察到的错误和广泛的信任间隔并不支持将该模型作为学术不当行为的独立证据。

blocks.en: Future work should evaluate the approach on other institutions, writing tasks, student populations, and forms of AI assistance. It should also examine performance across different groups and determine how much text is needed for reliable classification. Future studies can also evaluate other ways of combining window predictions and combine stylometric features with behavioral information when writing-process data are available.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作应评估其他机构、写作任务、学生人数和大赦国际援助形式的做法。 它还应审查不同组别的业绩,并确定可靠分类需要多少案文。 未来的研究还可以评价其他方法,在有写作-过程数据时,将窗口预测与时态特征与行为信息相结合.
